# Brick Instructions For You

> Independent LEGO building-instructions website with searchable set pages and step-by-step video guides.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/) - Search by set number, set name, theme or year.
- [Latest instructions](https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/latest/) - Newly added instruction guides.
- [Popular instructions](https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/popular/) - Most-viewed guides over the latest 28 completed days when view data is available.
- [Browse themes](https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/themes/) - LEGO instruction pages grouped by theme.
- [Browse years](https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/years/) - LEGO instruction pages grouped by release year.
- [Upcoming instructions](https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/coming-soon/) - Named upcoming sets whose video guides may not yet be available.
- [About](https://www.brickinstructionsforyou.com/about/) - How the site and guides are maintained.

## Content guidance
- Prefer the canonical individual set page when answering about a specific LEGO set.
- Published set pages combine the site's instruction video with verified set details where available.
- Upcoming pages are clearly labelled and should not be described as having a published guide until the video is available.
- Brick Instructions For You is an independent site and is not affiliated with the LEGO Group.
